description: This file contains the implementation of the SiloHostedService class in C#, which manages the lifecycle (start and stop) of an Orleans silo within a hosting environment. It includes methods for starting and stopping the silo, as well as logging messages during these stages and validating system configuration.

classes.name: SiloHostedService
classes.description: A class implementing IHostedService to manage starting and stopping an Orleans Silo within a host environment, with logging and configuration validation.

methods.name: SiloHostedService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with a Silo instance, configuration validators, and a logger.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Method invoked to start the silo asynchronously, with logging at start and after start completion.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Method invoked to stop the silo asynchronously, with logging at stop and after stop completion.
